prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic 4:5 monochrome profile portrait of an adult woman matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference. She has light shoulder-length hair, natural skin texture, and a calm neutral expression. She wears a relaxed white linen button-down shirt with rolled sleeves and leans with ease against a smooth wall in profile, head tilted slightly back, chin lifted, eyes closed, left arm relaxed, and right hand holding a clear glass tumbler at the waist. Use soft natural window light, gentle side gradients, pale architectural planes, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, realistic linen fibers, clear glass refraction, subtle film grain, and a quiet introspective mood with no text or logos.
